observations.behavior: Adds scanner_id parameter to the feed URL and filters results by scanner_ids; P1.F1.H1 also adds a test assertion and a row outside the scanner selection does not count.
observations.posthog_connection: Replay Vision backend exposes a feed endpoint that accepts scanner_ids, allowing the client to request results only for selected scanners; the test checks that observations not belonging to the selected scanner are excluded.

observations.behavior: Restructures embedding pick selection to use a Python-side set membership check against scanner_ids rather than a database join, and collects reach metrics per group root.
